StudentProfile.description: Activated student account linked 1:1 with Firebase Auth UID.

fields.isEligible: boolean (authoritative EC voter clearance, defaults false)

VoterEligibility.description: Authoritative EC voter eligibility record, decoupled from email verification.

AdminProfile.description: Electoral Commission / Domain Administrator record aligned with Auth custom claims.

HallUnit.description: Official UCC Hall of Residence units (Adehye, Atlantic, Casely Hayford, Kwame Nkrumah, Oguaa, Valco, SRC Hall, Superannuation Hall) with optional verified emblem logoUrl.

fields.code: string (ADH | ATL | CHF | KNH | OGU | VLC | SRH | SUP)
fields.name: string

Election.description: Election configuration, scheduling, domain scope (including hallId for JCRC / Hall elections), eligibility criteria, and guidelinesUrl.

Position.description: Contested portfolio linked via electionId, domainId, and optional hallId / facultyId / departmentId.

ContestantProfile.description: Permanent reusable UCC contestant profile shared across elections (admin-readable only due to contact PII).

CandidateAssignment.description: Transactional uniqueness index enforcing at most one candidate entry per (electionId, positionId, contestant/studentId).

Candidate.description: Election-specific candidate participation record linked via contestantId to ContestantProfile, holding positionId, manifesto, campaignStatement, electionPhotoUrl, vetting status, and tallies.

VoterAuthorisation.description: Transactional duplicate-vote prevention lock written strictly by submitBallot Cloud Function.

Ballot.description: Anonymized ballot box record containing ONLY electionId, selections map, and castAt (zero uid/studentId).

VoteConfirmation.description: Voter receipt confirmation without candidate choices.

ElectionResult.description: Certified or staged election results published only after authorization.

Notification.description: Broadcast (targetUid == null) or targeted (targetUid == uid) alerts.

Complaint.description: Student electoral complaint or support ticket with optional Storage attachment.

AuditLog.description: Immutable administrative and security audit trail.
